subsystem.name: Tactical Strategy RPG Grid Mechanics & Formations Subsystem
axioms: Discrete Cartesian integer coordinates bounded in [0, 64) x [0, 64)
Zero-heap pathfinding and movement cost calculations
Movement budgets (MP) strictly conserved and non-negative
Zone-of-Control (ZOC) pin rules halt contiguous traversal unless warded
